name: UCI Occupancy Detection Dataset
description: The UCI Occupancy Detection dataset is an experimental environmental sensing benchmark for room occupancy classification. Collected by Luis Candanedo and Vincent Feldheim at the University of Mons, it contains 20,560 one-minute sensor readings spanning temperature, humidity, light, carbon dioxide, and humidity ratio across three chronological experimental partitions.

size.notes: Text tabular files containing timestamped environmental measurements and ground truth binary camera-verified occupancy.
